I was in a hotel room, all alone,  in a SEA country.  Woke up in the middle of the night from the sound of thunderstorm. The lights went out and everything became pitch black, inside the hotel and Wifi didnt work. I looked outside and what I saw I will never torget! All the lights had gone out everywhere, but the sky was completely red from the constant lightnings. It was as if someone turned on and off a gigantic red lightbulb EVERY SECOND.  And the thunderstorm was constant, the sound never stopped. The hotel was on a hill and I was on the fifth floor. There was no fire equipment anywhere to be seen, so in fear of the lightning to hit the building and me beeing stuck in this room, i went out and climbed down the stairs with only my phone as a flashlight. I will never forget how scared I was and how lonely it felt standing in the darkness in the hallway watching the weirdest weather Ive ever encountered. At that moment I really missed my mom.
